scenarios.label: bull
scenarios.drivers: Bookings growth re-accelerates (~+4pp vs FY2025 pace), SG&A leverage resumes improving, insurance-cost tailwind banked not reinvested, Delivery Hero deal closes without integration drag, market grants a multiple modestly above the raw unadjusted core-peer median (14.42x) given Uber's highest-in-set EBITDA margin.

derivation.source: 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3 (forward NTM EBITDA x multiple, bridged with 01's canonical net debt/minority)

scenarios.label: base
scenarios.drivers: Consensus growth/margin path holds (9-analyst NTM consensus); market closes roughly a third of today's ~-17.5% NTM EV/EBITDA discount to the quality-adjusted peer level (13.0x), landing at 13.25x — still below the raw 14.42x peer median, reflecting the unresolved 'No moat proven' and rate-of-change (AV-disintermediation) caveats.

derivation.source: 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3 (forward NTM EBITDA x multiple, bridged with 01's canonical net debt/minority)

scenarios.label: bear_cyclical
scenarios.drivers: Bookings deceleration continues while cost base cannot flex down as fast (SG&A semi-fixed in a real slowdown, SG&A-reversal already +63bps off FY2025 low); widened -25% EBITDA move (vs a naive linear -21.6%) reflecting Freight's chronic weakness and cited prior downturns (FY2021 consolidated EBITDA margin -16.8%); multiple compresses to 10.0x, toward Lyft's 7.94x NTM EV/EBITDA. 12-month horizon (cyclical trough).

derivation.source: 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3 (forward NTM EBITDA x multiple, bridged with 01's canonical net debt/minority)

scenarios.label: bear_structural
scenarios.drivers: 24-36 month structural-reset / avoid-ruin floor, not the headline bear. Declining-perpetuity (runoff) DCF terminal: terminal EBIT margin faded to a non-recovering 8.0% (vs base-case plateau of 16.0%; LTM actual 12.1%) and terminal growth of -2.0% (genuine negative nominal trajectory) reflecting a structural reset — e.g. a major-market driver-classification ruling or AV disintermediation. Reused verbatim from 04_intrinsic-dcf.md §5; carried to the master synthesizer's Kill Criteria (CLAUDE.md §24), not blended into the headline bear.

derivation.source: 04_intrinsic-dcf.md §5 executed bridge (runoff terminal), reused verbatim in 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3
